title: Beyazıt Tower
note: The exact-identity square-base axes are combined with the north entrance identified in the published survey. The native +Z portal faces north-north-west; the surveyed base, rather than the larger projecting circular cornice, controls plan scale. The paper’s printed geographic coordinate differs from the exact mapped footprint; placement uses the map footprint center. The common 85 m tourist height is not reconciled with the published 67 m masonry plus 12 m pole survey and is not used to stretch the model. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
